chapters.text: Photo of the bill, amount, tap a category, save — about 10 seconds.
Open Finance → Add expense (phone), or hold the AMS icon on your home screen and pick Add expense.
Tap Take a photo of the bill. AMS reads the printed bill on the phone (free, no internet service needed) and fills the amount, date and shop. The photo is saved as a PDF.
Check the amount and category (tap a chip to change it).
Check Paid by, write Paid to, and tap Save expense. Card, bill number and other bill details can be added later on the entry (Edit).
